title: Smoky Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican dish featuring smoky chicken in tacos.

ingredients.name: smoky chipotle peppers in adobo sauce

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chipotle peppers, lime juice, oregano, salt, chili powder, and cumin. Blend until smooth.
Season the chicken breasts with the blended sauce and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is baking, warm the taco shells according to package instructions.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of chicken onto a warmed taco shell, followed by a sprinkle of cheese and a sprinkle of cilantro.
